name: Pritika Auto Industries Ltd
title: Pritika Auto Industries Ltd - 539359 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Utilisation ~73% of 72,000 t capacity with 7,800 t added in H1 FY27; Q4 EBITDA margin fell to 12.02% on raw-material and gas cost spikes, with management guiding a return to 15-16% if the war does not disrupt further.

utilisation.quote: at present we are doing roughly 73% -- maximum we can go up to 80% to 85%.

capex.quote: we plan to add around 7,800 tons this year.

guidance.value: around 15% a year for next two years; INR600 crore medium-term revenue target
guidance.quote: we expect to grow by around 15% this year.
This year capex will be roughly around INR25 to INR30 crores

guidance.value: ~80,000 t after 7,800 t greenfield foundry add in H1 FY27; >1 lakh t by FY28 with 20,000-24,000 t LFC
guidance.quote: we will add 20,000-24,000 tons in LFC technology so that our capacity, our overall, we will cross 1 lakh tons.

guidance.value: return to 15-16% if no further war disruption
guidance.quote: if there is no further disruptions due to war, we should reach back to our original margins.
That is a long-term our project to take this to 30% in next three years.

red_flags.label: Q4 EBITDA margin 12.02% vs 16-17% earlier; debt up ~INR180 cr for capex
red_flags.quote: they've come down to 12% this quarter.

red_flags.label: Management gave inconsistent growth and capacity numbers (6-8% customer view vs 15% own; 7,800 t vs 8,000 t)
red_flags.quote: We plan to add around 7,800 tons this year.

red_flags.label: Hoshiarpur land auction withdrawn after litigation
red_flags.quote: So then we withdrew ourselves from the auction.

evasions.topic: Margin recovery timing and cost pass-through
evasions.quote: Yes, yes. Coming this year, and if there is no further disruptions due to war, we should reach back to our original margins.
It depends, I mean, we will prefer a -- if we can do it fully with equity and as much as equity as possible and less of debt.

triggers.label: Utilisation ~73%, headroom to 80-85%
triggers.quote: at present we are doing roughly 73% -- maximum we can go up to 80% to 85%.

triggers.label: 7,800 t foundry add in H1 FY27
triggers.quote: this year we plan to add another approximately 7,800, which we will add in H1.

triggers.label: Q4 EBITDA margin 12.02% on RM spike
triggers.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR16.64 crores with an EBITDA margin of 12.02%.

triggers.label: Margin recovery to 15-16% guided
triggers.quote: if there is no further disruptions due to war, we should reach back to our original margins.
